---
title: "Sources and maintenance policy"
---

The textbook's proofs are written from definitions and checked independently;
a linked editorial is supporting evidence, not permission to copy its claims.
The rewrite found mistakes even in official-hosted explanatory material.
Small exhaustive calculations complement proofs but do not certify arbitrary
instances or randomized error bounds.

## Verification records

The repository maintains CONTENT_AUDIT.md as the complete original chapter
inventory and disposition tracker, CURRICULUM.md as the editorial dependency
plan, and VALIDATION_REPORT.md as the integrated result. Detailed
AUDIT and VALIDATION documents record chapter findings and checks.
Exact small-instance oracles live under tests/; site checks under scripts/.
HTTP reachability and mathematical relevance are recorded separately.

Original exercises include local solutions. External statements are linked
instead of reproduced. Where a site blocks automated access, the validation
report states that limitation; it is neither a confirmed broken link nor a
successful content check.

## Trust order

1. Official problem statements and official contest editorials.
2. Official library specifications and verification suites.
3. Author or setter tutorials, and established Codeforces tutorials.
4. Standard references such as *Concrete Mathematics* or Stanley's
   *Enumerative Combinatorics* for theorem statements.
5. Community explanations, used only after checking the mathematics.

Core online references used throughout the course:

- [AtCoder Library documentation](https://atcoder.github.io/ac-library/production/document_en/)
- [CP-Algorithms](https://cp-algorithms.com/)
- [Codeforces: Generating Functions, Part 1](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/77468)
- [Codeforces: Generating Functions, Part 2](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/77551)
- [Codeforces: Lagrange inversion theorem](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/104184)
- [Codeforces: zeta/Möbius transforms and convolutions](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/119082)
- [AtCoder: q-binomial coefficients](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc278/editorial/5238)
- [Codeforces: finite-field polynomial factorization](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/104318)
- [Codeforces: set power series](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/92128)
- [Codeforces: polynomial composition of set series](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/92183)
- [AtCoder: Tutte matrices and weighted matching](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc412/editorial/13395?lang=en)
- [Codeforces: D-finite functions, theory](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/138078)
- [Codeforces: D-finite functions, problems](https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/138113)
- [Codeforces problemset](https://codeforces.com/problemset)
- [AtCoder contests](https://atcoder.jp/contests/)
- [ICPC World Finals problem archive](https://icpc.global/worldfinals/problems)
- [QOJ / Universal Cup](https://qoj.ac/)

## Link conventions

- Link directly to a task, not a search result.
- Link an official editorial separately from the statement.
- Mark `[JA]`, `[ZH]`, or another language code when the target is not English.
- Codeforces ratings are recorded only when the problem page supplies one.
- Native scores and ratings are optional metadata and should be omitted if
  they have not been verified; course-relative difficulty is sufficient.
- ICPC and Universal Cup problems receive only the course's local level; an
  invented numeric rating is worse than no rating.

## Copyright and spoilers

Problem statements and editorials are not mirrored.  Each practice entry says
what skill it trains and supplies progressively stronger hints in collapsed
blocks.  Those hints should reconstruct the decisive reduction, not reproduce
an implementation or the original editorial.

## Link rot

Contest sites occasionally move PDF editorials.  If a link dies, retain the
contest, year, round, and problem letter in the entry so it remains searchable;
then prefer a new official URL over an unofficial mirror.  The last mechanical
link audit is recorded in the repository handoff rather than claimed permanently
inside these notes.

## Multilingual FPS & Generating Functions Bibliography (`Ch 01`–`Ch 24`) {#fps-bibliography}

The 24-chapter Formal Power Series & Generating Functions textbook consolidates foundational monographs, symbolic computation breakthroughs, Chinese IOI National Training Team papers (`国家集训队论文`), and Japanese/English competitive programming treatises across five canonical categories.

### Category I · Foundational Textbooks & Monographs (`[EN]`)

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`[EN-Bk-FS09]`** | **Philippe Flajolet & Robert Sedgewick (2009)**, *Analytic Combinatorics*, Cambridge University Press. Free PDF: [algo.inria.fr](https://algo.inria.fr/flajolet/Publications/AnaCombi/anacombi.html) | Definitive reference for the **Symbolic Method** ($\operatorname{SEQ}, \operatorname{MSET}, \operatorname{PSET}, \operatorname{CYC}, \operatorname{SET}$, Boxed Product $\mathcal{A}^{\square} \star \mathcal{B}$, Pointing $\Theta = x\partial_x$), autocorrelation polynomials, Smirnov words, PGFs, tree/cactus/block-cut equations, Lagrange–Bürmann inversion, and holonomic (D-finite) functions (`Ch 03, 04, 08, 10, 12, 14, 18`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-St97]`** | **Richard P. Stanley (1997 / 2011)**, *Enumerative Combinatorics, Volume 1* (2nd ed.), Cambridge University Press. URL: [math.mit.edu/~rstan/ec](https://math.mit.edu/~rstan/ec/) | Formal power series ring $K[[x]]$ and valuation topology, **Rota's Twelvefold Way**, $q$-analogues, Gaussian binomials $\binom{n}{k}_q$, subspaces of $\mathbb{F}_q^n$, Ferrers diagrams, Durfee squares, Euler's Pentagonal Number Theorem, Transfer Matrix Method $(I - xA)^{-1}$, and Trace–Log identity (`Ch 01, 03, 04, 05, 13, 23`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-St99]`** | **Richard P. Stanley (1999)**, *Enumerative Combinatorics, Volume 2*, Cambridge University Press. URL: [math.mit.edu/~rstan/ec](https://math.mit.edu/~rstan/ec/) | **Exponential Formula** $\widehat{G}(x) = \exp(\widehat{C}(x))$, algebraic/residue/combinatorial proofs of **Lagrange Inversion** via Cycle Lemma and Prüfer codes, and theory of **Rational, Algebraic, and D-Finite (Holonomic) Power Series**, P-recursive sequences, Hadamard products, diagonals, and **Furstenberg's Theorem** (`Ch 04, 11, 13, 16, 18, 19`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-Wi94]`** | **Herbert S. Wilf (1994 / 2006)**, *generatingfunctionology* (2nd / 3rd ed.), Academic Press / A K Peters. Free PDF: [math.upenn.edu/~wilf](https://www2.math.upenn.edu/~wilf/DownldGF.html) | Rules of formal calculus ($\vartheta = xD$, shift operators), 1D/2D recurrence-to-GF translation, Exponential Formula, **The Snake Oil Method** for binomial sums, elementary Lagrange Inversion, and Dirichlet generating functions (`Ch 02, 04, 06, 11, 24`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-GKP94]`** | **Ronald L. Graham, Donald E. Knuth, & Oren Patashnik (1994)**, *Concrete Mathematics* (2nd ed.), Addison-Wesley. | Iverson bracket calculus, upper negation $\binom{-r}{k} = (-1)^k \binom{r+k-1}{k}$, Chu–Vandermonde, Stirling numbers, Eulerian numbers $\left\langle\begin{matrix}n\\k\end{matrix}\right\rangle$, Worpitzky's identity, generalized binomial/exponential series $\mathcal{B}_t(z), \mathcal{E}_t(z)$, **Raney's Lemma**, and PGFs/Penney's game (`Ch 06, 08, 11, 14`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-He74]`** | **Peter Henrici (1974)**, *Applied and Computational Complex Analysis, Volume 1*, Wiley-Interscience. | Algebraic theory of **Formal Laurent Series** $K((x))$, **Formal Residue Calculus** ($\operatorname{Res}_{x=0} A'(x) = 0$, Jacobi's change-of-variables formula), and Bürmann–Lagrange inversion without contour integration (`Ch 11`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-Eg84]`** | **G. P. Egorychev (1984)**, *Integral Representation and the Computation of Combinatorial Sums*, AMS Translations of Mathematical Monographs, Vol. 59. | Formalizes the **Method of Coefficients** ($[x^n]$ operator rules, substitution rule, and double-residue elimination of multi-index binomial sums) (`Ch 06, 11`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-GJ83]`** | **Ian P. Goulden & David M. Jackson (1983 / 2004)**, *Combinatorial Enumeration*, Wiley / Dover. | Matrix/operator treatment of the **Goulden–Jackson Cluster Method** for overlapping forbidden substrings, Smirnov words, symmetric functions, MacMahon's Master Theorem, and multivariate Good–Lagrange inversion (`Ch 08, 17`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-BLL98]`** | **François Bergeron, Gilbert Labelle, & Pierre Leroux (1998)**, *Combinatorial Species and Tree-like Structures*, Cambridge University Press. | Species-theoretic foundations of pointing $\mathcal{A}^\bullet$, **Otter's Dissimilarity Theorem** ($\mathcal{T}_\bullet + \mathcal{T}_{\bullet-\bullet} = \mathcal{T} + \mathcal{T}_{\bullet\to\bullet}$), and **Block-Cut Tree Dissymmetry** for cacti and biconnected graphs (`Ch 10, 12`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-HP73]`** | **Frank Harary & Edgar M. Palmer (1973)**, *Graphical Enumeration*, Academic Press. | Classical treatise on labeled and unlabeled graph enumeration: connected graphs, Eulerian graphs, bipartite graphs, tournaments, strongly connected digraphs, Husimi cacti, and 2-connected blocks (`Ch 03, 10, 12, 13`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-PWZ96]`** | **Marko Petkovšek, Herbert S. Wilf, & Doron Zeilberger (1996)**, *A = B*, A K Peters / CRC Press. Free PDF: [math.upenn.edu/~wilf/AeqB.html](https://www2.math.upenn.edu/~wilf/AeqB.html) | Hypergeometric terms, Gosper's algorithm, and **Zeilberger's Creative Telescoping (WZ) Algorithm** for proving binomial identities and extracting P-recursive recurrences (`Ch 19`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-KP11]`** | **Manuel Kauers & Peter Paule (2011)**, *The Concrete Tetrahedron*, Springer. | Algorithmic conversion between polynomial-coefficient ODEs (D-finite equations) and P-recursive sequence recurrences, and closure algorithms for holonomic series (`Ch 18, 19`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-Kn11]`** | **Donald E. Knuth (2011)**, *The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 4A*, Addison-Wesley (§7.2.1.6). | Quadratic rational substitutions $x = u/(1 + au + cu^2)$ diagonalizing Catalan, Motzkin, Delannoy, and Schröder radicals, alongside Raney's Lemma and Łukasiewicz tree encodings (`Ch 11, 15`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-KC02]`** | **Victor Kac & Pokman Cheung (2002)**, *Quantum Calculus*, Springer. | Algebraic treatment of $q$-derivatives, $q$-shift operators, Gauss's $q$-binomial polynomial, and Cauchy's $q$-binomial theorem (`Ch 23`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-Ma15]`** | **Percy A. MacMahon (1915 / 1916)**, *Combinatory Analysis, Volumes 1 & 2*, Cambridge University Press. | Origin of **MacMahon's Master Theorem** ($[\mathbf{x}^{\mathbf{n}}] \prod_i L_i(\mathbf{x})^{n_i} = [\mathbf{x}^{\mathbf{n}}] \det(I - X A)^{-1}$) and $q$-statistics on permutations (`Ch 17, 23`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-BCG17]`** | **Alin Bostan, Frédéric Chyzak, Marc Giusti, Romain Lebreton, Grégoire Lecerf, Bruno Salvy, & Éric Schost (2017)**, *Algorithmes Efficaces en Calcul Formel* ([HAL-01646057](https://hal.science/hal-01646057)). | Comprehensive symbolic computation monograph covering Newton iteration, Tellegen's transposition principle, middle product `mulT`, subproduct trees, Taylor shift, algebraic series, and D-finite ODEs (`Ch 01, 02, 05, 06, 18, 20, 21`). |
| **`[EN-Bk-PW13]`** | **Robin Pemantle & Mark C. Wilson (2013)**, *Analytic Combinatorics in Several Variables*, Cambridge University Press. | Multivariate generating functions and residue extraction of diagonals of rational functions (`Ch 16, 17`). |

## Multilingual Terminology Rosetta Stone (`[EN]` $\leftrightarrow$ `[ZH]` $\leftrightarrow$ `[JA]`) {#fps-rosetta-stone}

This 75-entry bidirectional dictionary translates every core algebraic object, transform, and algorithm across English combinatorics (`[EN]`), Chinese Olympiad literature (`[ZH]`), and Japanese competitive programming blogs (`[JA]`).

### 1 · Rings, Formal Calculus, Symbolic Method & Generating Function Families (Entries 1–16)

| # | English (`[EN]`) Term | Chinese (`[ZH]`) Term | Japanese (`[JA]`) Term | Canonical Mathematical Operator / Formula |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Formal Power Series (FPS)** | 形式幂级数 | 形式的べき級数 (FPS) | $F(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} f_n x^n \in K[[x]]$ |
| **2** | **Formal Laurent Series** | 形式洛朗级数 | 形式的ローラン級数 | $A(x) = \sum_{n=v}^{\infty} a_n x^n \in K((x)), \; v \in \mathbb{Z}$ |
| **3** | **Valuation / Order of Series** | 级数的阶 / 最低次非零项次数 | 次数 / オーダー ($\operatorname{ord}_x F$) | $\nu(F) = \operatorname{val}(F) = \min\{n : f_n \neq 0\}$ |
| **4** | **Ordinary Generating Function (OGF)** | 普通生成函数 (OGF) | 通常母関数 (OGF) | $A(x) = \sum_{n \ge 0} a_n x^n$, $[x^n](A \cdot B) = \sum_{k=0}^n a_k b_{n-k}$ |
| **5** | **Exponential Generating Function (EGF)** | 指数生成函数 (EGF) | 指数型母関数 (EGF) | $\widehat{A}(x) = \sum_{n \ge 0} a_n \frac{x^n}{n!}$, $n!\,[x^n](\widehat{A}\widehat{B}) = \sum_k \binom{n}{k} a_k b_{n-k}$ |
| **6** | **Probability Generating Function (PGF)** | 概率生成函数 (PGF) | 確率母関数 (PGF) | $F_X(x) = \mathbb{E}[x^X] = \sum_{n \ge 0} \mathbb{P}(X = n) x^n, \; F_X(1) = 1$ |
| **7** | **Dirichlet Generating Function (DGF)** | 狄利克雷生成函数 (DGF) | ディリクレ母関数 (DGF) | $\mathcal{D}_f(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{f(n)}{n^s}$, $(f * g)(n) = \sum_{d \mid n} f(d)g(n/d)$ |
| **8** | **Set Power Series (SPS)** | 集合幂级数 | 集合べき級数 (SPS) | $F(x) = \sum_{S \subseteq [n]} f_S x^S \in K[x_1, \dots, x_n]/(x_1^2, \dots, x_n^2)$ |
| **9** | **Symbolic Method** | 符号化方法 | 記号法 (Symbolic Method) | $\mathcal{A} + \mathcal{B} \mapsto A+B, \; \mathcal{A}\times\mathcal{B} \mapsto AB, \; \operatorname{SEQ}(\mathcal{A}) \mapsto \frac{1}{1-A}$ |
| **10** | **Exponential Formula ($\operatorname{SET}$ / $\exp$ & $\ln$)** | 多项式 $\exp / \ln$ 的组合意义 (有标号连通-一般图转化) | 指数公式 ($\operatorname{SET}$ 構成 / 連結成分分解) | $\widehat{G}(x) = \exp\!\bigl(\widehat{C}(x)\bigr) \iff \widehat{C}(x) = \ln \widehat{G}(x)$ |
| **11** | **Euler Transform ($\operatorname{MSET}$)** | 欧拉变换 (无标号多重集 $\operatorname{MSET}$) | オイラー変換 ($\operatorname{MSET}$ 構成) | $\prod_{n \ge 1} (1 - x^n)^{-a_n} = \exp\!\left(\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{A(x^k)}{k}\right)$ |
| **12** | **Inverse Euler Transform** | 逆欧拉变换 (无标号连通块提取) | 逆オイラー変換 | $A(x) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{\mu(k)}{k} \ln G(x^k)$ |
| **13** | **Boxed Product (Min-Label Anchored Product)** | 标号最小元定根卷积 (Boxed Product) | 最小ラベル固定積 (Boxed Product) | $\mathcal{C} = \mathcal{A}^{\square} \star \mathcal{B} \iff \widehat{C}'(x) = \widehat{A}'(x) \widehat{B}(x)$ |
| **14** | **Pointing & Unpointing Operator** | 有标号定根 ($\Theta = xD$) 与去根 ($\Theta^{-1}$) | 根付き化 (Pointing) と非根付き化 | $\widehat{\Theta\mathcal{A}}(x) = x \frac{d}{dx} \widehat{A}(x), \; \widehat{A}(x) = \int_0^x \frac{\widehat{\Theta\mathcal{A}}(t)}{t}\,dt$ |
| **15** | **Otter's Dissimilarity Theorem** | 无根树同构去重定理 (特征点-特征边定理) | Otter の非類似性定理 | $V^*(\tau) - (E^*(\tau) - E_{\text{sym}}(\tau)) = 1 \implies U(x) = T(x) - \frac{1}{2}(T(x)^2 - T(x^2))$ |
| **16** | **Rota's Twelvefold Way** | 十二重计数法 (`Luogu P5824`) | 写像12相 (Twelvefold Way) | 12-case matrix of $\{L, U\}_{\text{balls}} \times \{L, U\}_{\text{boxes}} \times \{\text{arb}, \le 1, \ge 1\}$ |

### 2 · DP Translation, Substitutions, Transforms, IE & PGFs (Entries 17–34)

| # | English (`[EN]`) Term | Chinese (`[ZH]`) Term | Japanese (`[JA]`) Term | Canonical Mathematical Operator / Formula |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **17** | **Reversible DP / Rollback Knapsack** | 可撤销背包 / 退背包 DP | 戻すDP (Reversible DP) | Multiply by $(1 + x^w)$ or $\frac{1-x^{c+1}}{1-x}$ to insert; divide to delete in $O(M)$ |
| **18** | **Prefix-Sum & Finite-Difference Operators** | 高维前缀和与高维差分生成函数 | 累積和と差分の作用素 | $[x^n](1-x)^{-k}A(x) = \sum_{i=0}^n \binom{n-i+k-1}{k-1}a_i$ |
| **19** | **The Snake Oil Method** | 蛇油法 (交换求和次序提取系数) | Snake Oil 法 (和の順序交換) | $\sum_k \binom{a+bk}{n-ck} f_k = [x^n] \sum_{k \ge 0} f_k x^{ck} (1+x)^{a+bk}$ |
| **20** | **Polynomial Taylor Shift** | 多项式平移 (泰勒展开平移) | 多項式の Taylor Shift (平行移動) | $F(x + c) \iff [x^k]F(x+c) = \frac{1}{k!} \sum_{n=k}^d (n! f_n) \frac{c^{n-k}}{(n-k)!}$ |
| **21** | **Falling-Factorial Polynomial (FFP)** | 下降幂多项式 | 下降階乗べき多項式 | $P(x) = \sum_{k=0}^n c_k x^{\underline{k}}, \quad \widehat{P}(t) = \sum_{i \ge 0} \frac{P(i)}{i!} t^i = C(t) e^t$ |
| **22** | **Euler Differential Operator $\vartheta = xD$** | 欧拉算子 $\vartheta = x \frac{d}{dx}$ (斯特林展开) | オイラー作用素 $\vartheta = x\frac{d}{dx}$ | $(xD)^k F(x) = \sum_{n \ge 0} n^k f_n x^n = \sum_{j=0}^k \left\{\begin{matrix}k\\j\end{matrix}\right\} x^j F^{(j)}(x)$ |
| **23** | **Roots of Unity Filter** | 单位根反演 | 1のべき根フィルター (Roots of Unity Filter) | $\sum_{n \equiv r \pmod m} f_n x^n = \frac{1}{m}\sum_{j=0}^{m-1} \omega_m^{-jr} F(\omega_m^j x)$ |
| **24** | **EGF-to-OGF Borel–Laplace Bridge** | 指数生成函数转普通生成函数 (Laplace-Borel 变换) | EGF から OGF へのボレル変換 | $\mathcal{L}\!\left\{\sum_{n \ge 0} a_n \frac{t^n}{n!}\right\} = \int_0^\infty e^{-t} \widehat{A}(xt)\,dt = \sum_{n \ge 0} a_n x^n$ |
| **25** | **Binomial Inversion (At-Least vs. Exact)** | 二项式反演 (钦定 $k$ 个 vs 恰好 $k$ 个) | 二項反転 (包除原理の母関数表現) | $A(x, y) = B(x, y - 1), \quad A(x, 0) = B(x, -1)$ |
| **26** | **Run-Length Inclusion–Exclusion** | 连续段容斥 | ランレングス包除 / 連続成分の包除原理 | $F_{\text{transfer}}(x) = \frac{W_{\text{target}}(x)}{1 + W_{\text{target}}(x)} = 1 - \frac{1}{1 + W_{\text{target}}(x)}$ |
| **27** | **Smirnov Words (Adjacent-Distinct Sequences)** | 相邻不同序列 / Smirnov 词 | 隣接要素が異なる列 (Smirnov 語) | $S(\mathbf{x}) = \left(1 - \sum_{i=1}^m \frac{x_i}{1 + x_i}\right)^{-1}$ |
| **28** | **Goulden–Jackson Cluster Method** | Goulden–Jackson 簇方法 (重叠禁止子串容斥) | Goulden–Jackson クラスター法 | $F(x) = \bigl(1 - \sigma x + \mathbf{1}^\top \mathbf{C}(x)^{-1} \mathbf{u}(x)\bigr)^{-1}$ |
| **29** | **Autocorrelation / KMP Border Polynomial** | 自相关多项式 / Border 多项式 | 自己相関多項式 / Border 多項式 | $C_S(x) = \sum_{k \in \operatorname{Border}(S)} c^k x^{\lvert S \rvert - k}$ |
| **30** | **Simple Permutations & Modular Decomposition Tree** | 简单排列 (`析点`) 与析合树 | 単純順列と Modular Decomposition 木 | $\frac{F(y) - F(y)^2}{1 + F(y)} = y + S\bigl(F(y)\bigr), \; F(y) = \sum_{n \ge 1} n! y^n$ |
| **31** | **Eulerian Numbers & Worpitzky's Identity** | 欧拉数 $\left\langle\begin{matrix}n\\k\end{matrix}\right\rangle$ 与 Worpitzky 恒等式 | オイラー数と Worpitzky の恒等式 | $\sum_{m \ge 0} (m+1)^n y^m = \frac{A_n(y)}{(1-y)^{n+1}}, \; A(x,y) = \frac{1-y}{e^{(y-1)x}-y}$ |
| **32** | **Stopping-Time Conservation Equation** | 停止时间辅助生成函数守恒方程 | 停止時刻と生存確率母関数の関係式 | $F(x) + (1 - x)G(x) = 1 \implies \mathbb{E}[T] = F'(1) = G(1)$ |
| **33** | **First-Passage Renewal & Pole Cancellation** | 首达时间生成函数与 $(1-x)$ 消极点 | 初到達母関数と $(1-x)$ 極の相殺 | $F_{u \to v}(x) = \frac{H_{u \to v}(x)}{H_{v \to v}(x)} = \frac{(1-x)H_{u \to v}(x)}{(1-x)H_{v \to v}(x)}$ |
| **34** | **Extended $k$-th Min-Max Inclusion–Exclusion** | 扩展 Min-Max 容斥 ($k$-th Min-Max) | 拡張 Min-Max 包除原理 | $\mathbb{E}[\operatorname{kthmax}_{i \in S} T_i] = \sum_{\lvert T \rvert \ge k} (-1)^{\lvert T \rvert - k}\binom{\lvert T \rvert - 1}{k-1}\mathbb{E}[\min_{i \in T} T_i]$ |

### 3 · Lagrange Inversion, Formal Residues, Trees, Graphs & Implicit Equations (Entries 35–50)

| # | English (`[EN]`) Term | Chinese (`[ZH]`) Term | Japanese (`[JA]`) Term | Canonical Mathematical Operator / Formula |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **35** | **Formal Residue Operator** | 形式留数算子 ($\operatorname{Res}_{x=0}$ / $\operatorname{res}_x$) | 形式的留数 ($\operatorname{Res}_{x=0}$ / $\operatorname{res}_x$) | $\operatorname{Res}_{x=0} A(x)\,dx = [x^{-1}]A(x), \; \operatorname{Res}_{x=0} A'(x)\,dx = 0$ |
| **36** | **Formal Residue Change of Variables** | 形式留数换元定理 (Jacobi 换元公式) | 形式的留数の変数変換公式 | $\operatorname{Res}_{x=0} A(x)\,dx = \operatorname{Res}_{u=0} A(G(u))G'(u)\,du \quad (\nu(G) = \operatorname{ord}_u G = 1)$ |
| **37** | **Compositional Inverse / Series Reversion** | 多项式复合逆 | 合成逆元 / 形式的べき級数の逆関数 | $F\bigl(G(x)\bigr) = G\bigl(F(x)\bigr) = x \iff G = F^{\langle -1 \rangle}$ |
| **38** | **Classical Lagrange Inversion Formula (LIF)** | 经典拉格朗日反演 | ラグランジュの反転公式 (LIF) | $[x^n] H(F(x)) = \frac{1}{n} [u^{n-1}] H'(u) \Phi(u)^n \quad (F = x\Phi(F))$ |
| **39** | **Derivative-Free / Residue LIF** | 另类拉格朗日反演 (避免除以 $n$) | 微分・除算を用いないラグランジュ反転 | $[x^n] H(F(x)) = [u^n] H(u)\!\left(1 - \frac{u\Phi'(u)}{\Phi(u)}\right)\!\Phi(u)^n$ |
| **40** | **Coupled Binomial Sum Linearization** | 炫酷反演魔术 (Elegia 二项式和换元线性化) | 留数変換による二項係数和の線形化 | For $S_n = \sum_{k=0}^n f_k \binom{\alpha n + \beta k + \gamma}{n - k}$: **Fixed $n$ ($O(n \log n)$)**: $[w^n] F(w) \frac{(1+g(w))^{(\alpha+\beta)n+\gamma+1}}{1+(\beta+1)g(w)}$ with $g(w)(1+g(w))^\beta = w$; **All $n$ ($O(N \log^2 N)$)**: $[z^n] F\bigl(A(z)(1+A(z))^\beta\bigr) \frac{(1+A(z))^{\gamma+1}}{1 - (\alpha-1)A(z)}$ with $A(z)(1+A(z))^{-\alpha} = z$ |
| **41** | **Raney's Lemma / Cycle Lemma** | 冉氏引理 (Raney 引理 / 循环引理) | Raney の補題 / Cycle Lemma | Sequence in $\mathbb{Z}_{\le 1}$ with $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i = -k < 0$ has $k$ valid cyclic shifts |
| **42** | **Łukasiewicz Path** | Łukasiewicz 路径 (DFS 先序出度减一序列) | ウカシェヴィチ経路 (Łukasiewicz Path) | Preorder DFS degree sequence $a_i = \deg^+(v_i) - 1 \ge -1, \; \sum a_i = -1$ |
| **43** | **Generalized Binomial Series $\mathcal{B}_t(x)$** | 广义二项级数 / Fuss–Catalan 级数 | 一般化二項級数 ($\mathcal{B}_t(x)$) | $\mathcal{B}_t(x) = 1 + x \mathcal{B}_t(x)^t = \sum_{n \ge 0} \frac{1}{tn+1}\binom{tn+1}{n} x^n$ |
| **44** | **Generalized Exponential / Tree Series $T(x)$ (Prüfer / Cayley)** | 广义指数级数 / 有标号有根树级数 $T(x)$ | 一般化指数級数 / ランベルトの $W$ 関数 (ケイリーの公式) | $T(x) = x e^{T(x)} = \sum_{n \ge 1} n^{n-1} \frac{x^n}{n!}, \; \mathcal{E}_t(x) = e^{x\mathcal{E}_t(x)^t} = \sum_{n \ge 0} \frac{(tn+1)^{n-1}}{n!} x^n$ |
| **45** | **Cactus Graph & Desert** | 仙人掌图与荒漠 (仙人掌森林) | サボテングラフ (Cactus) と砂漠 | Rooted $R(x) = x\exp\!\left(\frac{2R-R^2}{2(1-R)}\right)$; Unrooted $C_{\text{cactus}}(x) = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{1}{1-R} + \frac{2R-5R^2+R^3}{4(1-R)}$; $c_n = \frac{r_n}{n} = \frac{(n-1)!}{n}[u^{n-1}]\exp\!\left(n\frac{2u-u^2}{2(1-u)}\right)$ (`Luogu P5434`) |
| **46** | **Vertex-Biconnected Graph & Block-Cut Tree** | 点双连通图与圆方树 (Block-Cut Tree) | 二重頂点連結グラフと Block-Cut Tree | $\widehat{R}(x) = x \exp\!\bigl(\widehat{B}'(\widehat{R}(x))\bigr) \implies b_n = -(n-2)!\,[x^{n-1}](\widehat{C}'(x))^{-(n-1)}$ |
| **47** | **2-Edge-Connected Graph & Bridge-Tree** | 边双连通图与缩桥树 | 二重辺連結グラフと Bridge-Tree | $\widehat{R}(x) = \widehat{B}_\bullet\!\bigl(x e^{\widehat{R}(x)}\bigr) \implies n!\,[u^n]\widehat{B} = (n-1)!\,[x^n]\widehat{R}(1+x\widehat{R}')e^{-n\widehat{R}}$ |

| **49** | **Frobenius–Lucas Base-$p$ Digit Decimation** | 弗罗贝尼乌斯自同态按 $p$ 进制数位约化 | フロベニウス自己準同型による $p$ 進桁 DP | $\Phi(u)^p \equiv \Phi(u^p) \pmod p \implies O(d p \log(dp) \log_p n)$ |
| **50** | **Functional Square Root** | 形式幂级数复合平方根 ($G(G(x)) = F(x)$) | 形式的べき級数の合成平方根 | $[x^k]G(G(x)) = g_1(1 + g_1^{k-1}) g_k + \text{lower}$ ($F(0)=0, g_1^2 \equiv f_1 \pmod p$; obstruction if $1 + g_1^{k-1} \equiv 0 \pmod p$); for $g_1=1$ over $\mathbb{F}_p$, $F^{\circ p}(x) \equiv x \pmod{x^{p+2}}$ gives $G \equiv F^{\circ((p+1)/2)} \pmod{x^N}$ for $N \le p+2$, while $N > p+2$ hits Artin–Schreier obstruction at $x^{p+2}$ (`fps_24_x`) |

| **53** | **2D Bostan–Mori ($x$-Halving / $y$-Doubling)** | 二元 Bostan–Mori ($x$ 折半、$y$ 倍增) | 二変数 Bostan–Mori 法 ($x$ 次数半減・$y$ 次数倍増) | Extract $[x^n]\frac{W(x)}{1-yf(x)} \bmod y^{n+1}$ with $N_r \cdot M_r = (n/2^r)\cdot 2^r = O(n)$ |

| **59** | **MacMahon's Master Theorem** | 麦克马洪主定理 (MacMahon Master Theorem) | マクマホンのマスター定理 | $[\mathbf{x}^{\mathbf{n}}] \prod_{i=1}^d \left(\sum_{j=1}^d A_{i,j} x_j\right)^{n_i} = [\mathbf{x}^{\mathbf{n}}] \frac{1}{\det(I - X A)}$ |
